1. The `InboxEvent` class is the base class for different event types
2. All inbox events need to store `id`, `user_id`, and `published` attributes
3. The current implementation just has `pass` and doesn't initialize these attributes

Looking at the child classes (`CommentedEvent`, `LikedEvent`, `FollowedEvent`), they all call `super().__init__(id, user_id, published)` which means the parent class needs to properly store these parameters.
